enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom, fan running for air circulation
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Fan runs continuously.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Gets out of bed. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes toilet. Washes hands. Turns on tap. Wets face. Applies soap. Rubs face. Rinses face. Turns off tap. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits. Wipes mouth. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Boiling the kettle, making toast and preparing a relaxed holiday breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Fills kettle with water. Places kettle on base. Turns on kettle. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread. Takes out butter. Takes out jam. Places bread in toaster. Pushes toaster lever. Waits. Kettle boils. Turns off kettle. Pours hot water into cup. Adds tea bag. Removes toast from toaster. Spreads butter. Spreads jam. Places on plate. Sits at table.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating breakfast with Member 2 in the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Member 2 sits opposite. Eats toast. Drinks tea. Talks with Member 2. Picks up cup. Puts down cup. Wipes mouth with napkin. Finishes eating. Stands up. Clears plate. Rinses plate. Places in sink.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying the living room and watering plants (vacuuming left to Member 2 later)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Picks up cushions. Fluffs cushions. Places on sofa. Picks up newspapers. Stacks newspapers. Places on shelf. Picks up remote control. Places on coffee table. Picks up watering can. Fills watering can in kitchen. Returns to living room. Waters plants. Checks soil. Moves plant pots. Wipes leaves with cloth. Returns watering can to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local shops for groceries and household supplies
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Walks along street. Enters shop. Picks up basket. Walks through aisles. Selects vegetables. Places in basket. Selects fruits. Selects milk. Selects bread. Selects household supplies. Walks to checkout. Places items on counter. Pays. Receives change. Packs items in bags. Picks up bags. Walks out of shop. Walks back home.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting away groceries and cooking a simple lunch on the induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Places bags on counter. Unpacks bags. Opens refrigerator. Places vegetables in crisper. Places milk in door. Places fruits in bowl. Places bread in breadbox. Places detergent under sink. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Places items. Closes cupboard. Takes out cutting board. Takes out knife. Chops vegetables. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs. Adds seasoning. Turns off cooker. Transfers to plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch with Member 2 and cleaning up the dishes afterwards
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table with Member 2. Eats lunch. Talks with Member 2. Finishes eating. Stands up. Picks up plates. Scrapes food into bin. Places plates in sink. Turns on tap. Rinses plates. Places in dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes table with cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with Member 2, air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Turns on air conditioner. Adjusts temperature. Surfs channels. Settles on program. Watches TV. Talks with Member 2. Adjusts volume.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing to relax on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Continues watching TV. Shifts position. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Puts down remote. Talks with Member 2. Checks phone. Puts down phone.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on personal computer at the desk lamp, reviewing community program notes and answering emails
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Logs in. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Opens program notes. Reads notes. Makes notes. Types. Saves file. Closes laptop. Turns off lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a walk in the park with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks out of house. Walks to park. Walks along path. Talks with Member 2. Observes surroundings. Stops to look at flowers. Continues walking. Sits on bench. Talks. Stands up. Walks back home.

enriched_activities.activity: Catching up with community contacts by phone while walking back home
enriched_activities.desc: Takes out phone. Dials number. Holds phone to ear. Speaks. Listens. Continues walking. Ends call. Dials another number. Speaks. Listens. Ends call. Puts phone in pocket. Walks home.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing ingredients and starting to cook dinner using the oven and induction cooker
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out chicken. Takes out vegetables. Places on counter. Washes vegetables. Chops vegetables. Seasons chicken. Turns on oven. Preheats oven. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Adds oil. Adds vegetables. Stirs.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner together with Member 2 in the kitchen
enriched_activities.desc: Member 2 enters. Talks with Member 2. Assigns tasks. Member 2 stirs pot. Member 1 checks oven. Takes out tray. Bastes chicken. Returns to oven. Adds sauce to pan. Stirs. Tastes. Adds salt. Turns off induction cooker. Turns off oven.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at table. Member 2 sits. Serves food. Eats. Talks. Drinks water. Picks up fork. Puts down fork. Finishes. Stands up. Clears plates. Scrapes. Places in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a movie on TV with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Selects movie. Adjusts volume. Watches. Talks with Member 2. Eats snacks. Picks up snack bowl. Puts down snack bowl. Adjusts position.

enriched_activities.activity: Playing a game on the game console
enriched_activities.desc: Picks up controller. Turns on game console. Selects game. Plays. Presses buttons. Moves controller. Talks with Member 2. Pauses game. Resumes. Finishes game. Turns off console. Puts down controller.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a warm shower with the water heater and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts temperature. Undresses. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Rubs. Rinses. Turns off water. Steps out. Dries with towel. Puts on pajamas. Brushes teeth. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading on the phone and dimming the desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits on bed. Picks up phone. Opens reading app. Reads. Scrolls. Turns off desk lamp. Puts down phone. Lies down. Adjusts pillow. Closes eyes.

enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping in own bedroom
enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Breathes. Occasionally turns. Fan runs.
